blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI 61st MPC Meeting: Policy Repo Rate Unchanged at 5.25% with Neutral Stance. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Projects FY27 Real GDP growth at 6.6% and CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) inflation at 5.1%.

Rate Decision: Repo rate kept unchanged at 5.25% (SDF (standing deposit facility without collateral) 5.00%, MSF (marginal standing facility for emergency borrowing)/Bank Rate 5.50%) under Neutral stance.
Macro Projections: FY27 Real GDP growth projected at 6.6% (Q1 6.6%, Q2 6.3%, Q3 6.5%, Q4 6.8%); CPI (consumer price index tracking retail inflation) inflation 5.1%.
Repo rate (5.25%) vs SDF (standing deposit facility without collateral) floor (5.00%) vs MSF (marginal standing facility for emergency borrowing) ceiling (5.50%).

blocks.title: 💼 Interview Question & Model Answer
blocks.text:
**Q:** Why has the MPC maintained a 'Neutral' stance amidst global macroeconomic uncertainties?

**Model Answer:** A neutral stance provides the RBI flexibility to balance domestic growth with inflation targets while monitoring global commodity price volatility.
